title: Docebo vs. Workday Skills Cloud: Which fits your skills strategy?
summary: Docebo vs. Workday Skills Cloud compared on skills intelligence, learning delivery, integrations, and external training. See which fits your team.
body_markdown:
Choosing between Docebo and Workday Skills Cloud comes down to this: do you need a skills layer for talent decisions inside Workday? A learning platform that delivers and proves training? Or a connected workflow across both?


Both vendors now pitch AI-driven skills, so feature lists naturally overlap. But they start from different places, which is an important distinction.


- **Workday Skills Cloud** is skills technology inside Workday’s HR software. Workday says it informs hiring, development, and mobility decisions.
- **Docebo** is an AI workforce readiness platform that connects skills intelligence, learning execution, and measurable outcomes in a single closed loop. Powered by 365Talents’ skills intelligence and talent mobility capabilities, it gives organizations the tools to close skills gaps, develop talent, and perform at their best in an AI-driven world.


Skills Cloud isn’t a learning platform. Workday sells that separately as Workday Learning. So the fair matchups are Workday Skills Cloud against[Docebo’s skills features](https://www.docebo.com/products/skills-intelligence/) , and Workday Learning against Docebo’s learning platform.


This guide compares the two on skills data, learning execution, compliance, external training, integrations, and pricing so you can decide which fits your organization best.


## Docebo vs. Workday Skills Cloud at a glance


Here’s the fast version: Docebo fits best when learning has to be delivered, governed, and proven for every audience, and skills decide what people learn next. Workday Skills Cloud fits best when skills-informed talent decisions live inside a Workday-centered stack. The table below compares both across 10 core areas.


Evaluation criteria Docebo Workday Skills Cloud Ideal fit

**Workday details come from Workday’s official product sources.*


## When Docebo is the better fit


**Learning administration is central to the purchase.** Your job is managing and delivering structured learning, and skills insight is just one part of that. Compare Docebo Learn with Workday Learning on assignments, certifications, reporting, and compliance. If mandatory training drives your audits, that comparison can help guide your purchase.


**You want skills to focus the learning.** In Docebo, a gap found in the skills view leads to targeted learner development in the same platform, without a handoff to a separate system. Progress is tracked beyond course completion, so you can see whether capability is moving and report back on it. That’s learning you can measure.


**Your skills strategy reaches beyond learning.** 365Talents, Docebo’s advanced skills solution, handles internal mobility, workforce planning, role and project matching, and skills-based career paths. It connects to your existing HR systems, so you can add skills intelligence without replacing your HRIS or LMS. It also gives employees a view of their own skills, career paths, and open roles and projects, which helps keep them engaged in their own development. It’s also priced separately. For basic skills use cases, like aligning learning to roles and guiding development, Docebo includes classic skills with the Elevate plan. 365Talents also brings:


- **Fit with your stack:** It connects to your existing HR systems, so you can add skills intelligence without replacing your HRIS or LMS.
- **Employee engagement:** Employees get a view of their own skills, career paths, and open roles and projects, which helps keep them engaged in their development.
- **Fast deployment:** 365Talents reports that[Eiffage Construction](https://365talents.com/en/resources/case_studies/client-use-case-eiffage-construction/) deployed the platform in six weeks, with 7,800 skills declared in 2025.


**You train customers, partners, or members.**[Docebo extended enterprise](https://www.docebo.com/products/extended-enterprise/) gives each audience its own branding, login, content catalog, and admin rights. Your partner academy and employee onboarding can run on one platform without sharing a login page. You can also bring employee, customer, and partner data together to see your learning impact on every audience.


**You run Workday but want a dedicated learning experience.**[Docebo Connect](https://www.docebo.com/integration/workday/) imports employee and organizational data from Workday into Docebo, so you can speed up onboarding enrollments for new hires, and segment learning by geography, department, and level. 365Talents also lists Workday among its supported HRIS connectors.


## When Workday Skills Cloud is the better fit


**Workday is the center of your talent architecture.** Workday says its skills technology is built into Recruiting, Learning, Talent Optimization, and People Analytics. If you run those modules, you get those connections inside one suite. That’s a real advantage when your talent processes already live there.


**The immediate need is skills-informed talent action.** Hiring, internal mobility, and development decisions matter more to you than replacing learning administration. Mobility is climbing the agenda.[LinkedIn’s 2025 Workplace Learning Report](https://business.linkedin.com/learn/resources/workplace-learning-report) found internal mobility is a higher priority for 55% of career development champions and 48% of other respondents.


**Your Workday modules already cover the workflows you need.** Job recommendations and a talent marketplace come through Talent Optimization. Verify which modules and licenses you’ve enabled in a customer-specific demo before you assume an advertised capability is included.


**HCM consolidation is a primary objective.** Suite consolidation is a fair goal: fewer vendors, fewer contracts, one place to look when something breaks. Weigh that against what each workflow needs, who owns it, and how data moves between systems.


## Docebo vs. Workday Skills Cloud: Detailed platform and capability breakdown


Both vendors describe skills, learning, and AI in similar terms, so a feature checklist won’t separate them neatly. Compare delivery, data flow, and ownership instead.


### Product scope: Skills Cloud, Workday Learning, and Docebo Learn


- **Docebo** is a workforce readiness platform. Docebo Learn is the learning platform, with classic skills in the Elevate plan and 365Talents as the advanced skills intelligence solution.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** is skills technology Workday builds into several products. Workday Learning, which is “powered by Sana,” is separate.


**Bottom line:** Workday Skills Cloud isn’t an LMS, and it isn’t a synonym for Workday Learning. For the LMS-level view, see our[Docebo vs. Workday vs. Sana comparison](https://www.docebo.com/learning-network/blog/docebo-sanalabs-workday/) .


### Skills data, inference, and governance


Skills data goes stale, fast. Employers in the[World Economic Forum’s Future of Jobs Report 2025](https://reports.weforum.org/docs/WEF_Future_of_Jobs_Report_2025.pdf) expect 39% of workers’ core skills to change by 2030. That’s down from 44% in 2023.


- **Docebo** uses AI to infer, normalize, and validate skills from roles, experience, learning activity, projects, and career moves.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** , according to Workday’s datasheet, “uses AI and machine learning to analyze organizational data, reveal how skills connect, and generate actionable insights that drive smarter talent decisions.”


**Bottom line:** Docebo is the stronger fit when skills data has to keep pace with how work changes. Fuel50 suits teams that want experts to define every skill. Docebo Skills Intelligence infers skills continuously from everyday work signals, drawing on a reference library of[10,600+ skills across 45 languages](https://365talents.com/en/resources/skills-graph-guide-hr-leaders/) , so you avoid a manual curation cycle. Similar AI language doesn’t mean equivalent methods, so ask where each signal comes from, how it’s validated, how an employee challenges it, and how often it refreshes.


### From skills gap to learning to evidence


- **Docebo** turns a gap detected in the skills view into targeted learning in Docebo Learn, with progress tracked beyond completion.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** surfaces personalized learning content tied to employee skills.


**Bottom line:** Choose Docebo if one platform should detect the gap, deliver the learning, and record the evidence. Ask each vendor whether its solution tells you what to develop, delivers the learning, and verifies whether capability improved. Completion shows activity, so ask what else counts as evidence.


### Learning management, compliance, and certification


Compliance comes down to which system keeps the record.


- **Docebo**[automates certification and compliance tracking](https://www.docebo.com/solutions/enterprise-learning-management/) , including enrollment and reporting, and Docebo Learn[supp](https://www.docebo.com/products/learn-lms/)[o](https://www.docebo.com/products/learn-lms/)[rts](https://www.docebo.com/products/learn-lms/) SCORM 1.2 and 2004, xAPI, and AICC content.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** isn’t the course administration system, so evaluate Workday Learning. Workday offers “assignment management, completion tracking, and audit trails” for compliance.


**Bottom line:** If your learning platform must be the system of record for mandatory training, choose Docebo, and run that test against Workday Learning.


### Mobility, hiring, career paths, and workforce planning


- **Docebo** supports internal mobility, role and project matching, skills-based career paths, and workforce planning through 365Talents.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** surfaces candidates with the right skills, plus job recommendations, a talent marketplace, and workforce insights.


**Bottom line:** Workday Skills Cloud has a natural advantage when these workflows must live inside Workday. Docebo with 365Talents fits when skills data should also drive learning alongside your existing HR stack.


### Customer and partner training


- **Docebo’s** extended enterprise runs separate experiences for customers, partners, and members, and lets you combine reporting across them.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** focuses on workforce skills and talent workflows. Workday documents Extended Enterprise Learning as a separate Workday Learning subscription for nonemployees, including partners.


**Bottom line:** If external training is a big part of your strategy, choose Docebo. Ask both vendors to demo your exact audience scenario.


### Integrations and system of record


- **Docebo** imports employee and organizational data from Workday through Docebo Connect, hourly by default.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** is native to Workday.


**Bottom line:** Docebo also offers a generic skills API for importing skills mapped in an external HR information system (HRIS). That API isn’t Workday-specific, needs to be built, and turns off Docebo’s own AI skill suggestions when enabled. Confirm data flows, owners, and refresh rates with both vendors during scoping.


### AI, knowledge, and agents


Separate what’s live from what’s announced.


- **Docebo** applies AI to course authoring, personalized learning recommendations, and skills mapping. Its MCP Server has been[generally available since July 2026](https://www.docebo.com/whatsnew/2026-july/) .
- **Workday Skills Cloud** is marketed with AI-based skills insights and recommendations.


**Bottom line:** Docebo[announced AgentHub on April 21, 2026](https://www.docebo.com/products/agenthub/) , with full availability planned for fall 2026, and lists Docebo Knowledge as coming soon. Compare specific tasks, guardrails, and what’s live on the day you sign.


### Implementation, security, and support


Effort depends on your existing stack, enabled modules, audiences, and integrations. Ask the same five questions to both vendors:


1. Which products, modules, and audiences are in scope first?
2. What data moves, in which direction, and how often?
3. Who owns the skills framework, catalog, and each integration?
4. Which security and privacy documents will each vendor share?
5. Who supports admins and learners after launch?


**Bottom line:** Write these into your demo script and compare answers side by side.


### Pricing and total cost of ownership


A per-user price comparison won’t work across different scopes.


- **Docebo** pricing is custom. Cost depends on plan (Elevate or Enterprise), audiences and active users, add-ons like extended enterprise, and whether 365Talents is in scope.
- **Workday Skills Cloud** cost depends on the Workday products and licenses involved.


**Bottom line:** Ask each vendor for a written quote for the same population, products, integrations, and term. Then compare total operating effort and cost.


### Customer proof


As a reminder, Docebo Skills Intelligence is powered by 365Talents. Below are some case studies from each vendor.


**SNCF:** 365Talents reports in its SNCF case study that six months after launch,[94% of SNCF’s 153,000+ employees had active profiles](https://365talents.com/en/resources/case_studies/customer-success-story-sncf-365talents/) .


**Société Générale:** 365Talents reports[nearly 74,000 Société Générale employees](https://365talents.com/en/resources/case_studies/client-use-case-societe-generale/) are on the platform. Cristèle Pernoud, Corporate Strategic Workforce Planning Lead, describes the goal:


> “Thanks to 365Talents, we are offering our employees personalized HR services based on their skills, so that they are involved in their own professional project, by helping them value themselves, think, and develop the skills of tomorrow…”


**SEGULA Technologies:** 365Talents reports that[SEGULA deployed the platform to 8,500+ employees in France](https://365talents.com/en/resources/case_studies/customer-use-case-segula-technologies/) , averaging 33+ declared skills per employee. Arnaud Andorra, Global Talent Manager, describes the starting point:


> “We didn’t have any harmonization of skills repositories across the Group, and it was essential to change that to meet our customers’ challenges in international markets.”


**Workday Skills Cloud:**[Workday’s Skills Cloud datasheet (February 2026)](https://www.workday.com/content/dam/web/en-us/documents/datasheets/workday-skills-cloud-datasheet-enus.pdf) reports a 26% higher internal hire rate and a 5% reduced voluntary turnover rate on average, based on product-level analysis across customers where data was available from July 2023 to June 2025. Workday doesn’t state a baseline or control group.


**Bottom line:** These results use different methods and definitions, so don’t compare them head to head.


## Which platform is the right choice for your team?


Start with what you’re buying. Is it skills technology for Workday talent decisions, a learning platform that delivers and proves training, or both working together? Answer these seven questions before the first demo.


1. **Is your primary need a skills layer, a learning platform, or both?** Start with Workday Skills Cloud for the first, Docebo for the second.
2. **Are compliance, certification, or mandatory training major requirements?** Docebo Learn is built for these workflows, so compare it with Workday Learning.
3. **Do skills need to drive internal mobility, workforce planning, or hiring?** Compare Workday Skills Cloud with Docebo plus 365Talents on your roles and data.
4. **Is Workday the center of your talent architecture, and is a suite strategy a priority?** Workday Skills Cloud is the natural fit.
5. **Do customers, partners, or members need training?** Docebo is better suited to extended enterprise learning.
6. **Do you need skills data to flow between Workday and your learning platform?** Docebo Connect imports employee and organizational data from Workday. Ask both vendors to walk through the data flows you need, in which direction, and how often.
7. **Can you compare matched quotes and scope?** Ask both vendors to price the same audiences, products, and integrations.


**Run this live demo with both vendors.** Walk one role with a defined skill gap through these steps:


1. Show where the skill signal comes from
2. Validate the gap
3. Recommend the next action
4. Deliver the learning
5. Show what evidence updates the profile


Add a customer, partner, or frontline audience if it’s part of your case.


Workday Skills Cloud is the practical choice for organizations that want to connect skills insight to Workday talent workflows inside one suite.


Docebo is the strategic choice for organizations that need to deliver, govern, and prove learning for every audience, with skills built in through Elevate and 365Talents.


Ready to see why more than 3,900 organizations and 30 million learners trust Docebo?[Take a tour](https://www.docebo.com/take-a-tour/) of the platform today or[book a demo](https://www.docebo.com/demo/) and bring your own skills-to-learning workflow.


## FAQs


### What is Workday Skills Cloud?


Workday Skills Cloud is Workday’s AI skills technology. It analyzes how skills connect across an organization and feeds hiring, learning, development, and mobility decisions.


### Is Workday Skills Cloud the same as Workday Learning?


No. Workday Skills Cloud is the skills layer, while Workday Learning is the separate, connected learning product to evaluate for compliance and certification needs.


### What is the difference between Docebo and Workday Skills Cloud?


Workday Skills Cloud is a skills layer in Workday’s talent ecosystem, while Docebo is a workforce readiness platform that combines learning with skills intelligence. Compare Skills Cloud with Docebo Skills Intelligence, and Workday Learning with Docebo Learn.


### Can Workday Skills Cloud replace a learning management system?


Test that question against Workday Learning, since Workday Skills Cloud covers skills insight and learning recommendations. Verify course administration, compliance, certification, reporting, and audience needs in the Workday products you’ve licensed.


### Does Docebo include skills intelligence?


Yes. Docebo includes classic skills with the Elevate plan for learning-led use cases, and 365Talents, priced separately, adds advanced skills intelligence for mobility and workforce planning.


### Can Docebo and Workday support customer or partner training?


Docebo offers extended enterprise for customers, partners, and members, with a separate experience for each. Workday documents a separate Extended Enterprise Learning subscription in Workday Learning, so ask Workday to demo your scenario.


### How much do Docebo and Workday Skills Cloud cost?


Neither vendor publishes a single price for this scope, and the two products cover different ground. Request matched written quotes for the same products, learner populations, integrations, and term.


### What are some alternatives to Workday Skills Cloud?


Alternatives include Eightfold AI (talent intelligence), Degreed (skills-first learning), Cornerstone (learning and talent management), and Gloat (talent marketplace).
